google-calendar.description: Google Calendar. Needs Node.js and an OAuth client JSON - see README.

strava.description: Strava - your activities (swim, bike, run). STRAVA_CLIENT_ID / STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET in .env, then once: uv run python server/strava_server.py --login

nutrition.description: Nutrition MCP (nutrition-mcp.com): meals, macros, weight, body measurements, nutrition goals. Log in once: uv run alfred mcp-login nutrition

knowledge-base.description: Your own notes / knowledge library as an MCP server (tools kb_find, kb_read, kb_list ...). Read-only from the brain.

browser.description: Browser automation for bookings (restaurants, appointments). Needs Node.js.
